config-recovery: a hand-edited config breaks, kb says where, and the fix works.

Each failure is one error line that names the file or the key, not a validation table. kb doctor
reports the same problem as a FAIL until the file is fixed.

  $ kb init --model fake:8
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model fake:8)

  $ kb add $WORK/notes/tmux.md
  added data/tmux.md (2 chunks)

A broken location file.

  $ write .kb/kb.toml @kbtoml-broken

  $ kb search tmux --mode fts
  [stderr] kb search: $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml:2: default_store: strings cannot contain newlines
  [exit 1]

  $ kb doctor
  FAIL location: $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml:2: default_store: strings cannot contain newlines
  doctor: 1 failed, 0 warnings
  [stderr] kb doctor: 1 check(s) failed
  [exit 1]

  $ write .kb/kb.toml @kbtoml-fixed

  $ kb doctor
  ok   config: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  ok   sources: 1 configured: "data" (entries)
  ~ ok   driver: fts5 enabled, sqlite [0-9.]+, sqlite-vec v[0-9.]+
  ok   embed_meta: model=fake:8 dim=8
  warn model: not checked (test embedder)
  ok   entries: 1 entries valid
  ok   db-vs-files: 1 entries in sync
  ok   index.md: absent (optional export)
  ~ ok   version: kb \(version\) at .*
  doctor: 0 failed, 1 warnings

An unknown key in the store's config.toml.

  $ write .kb/stores/default/config.toml @config-badkey

  $ kb config
  [stderr] kb config: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml: unknown key "search.rrf_kk"
  [exit 1]

  $ kb doctor
  ~ FAIL config: \$WORK/proj/\.kb/stores/default/config\.toml: unknown key "search\.rrf_kk"
  ...
  ~ doctor: \d+ failed, 0 warnings
  [stderr] ~ kb doctor: \d+ check\(s\) failed
  [exit 1]

  $ kb search tmux --mode fts
  [stderr] kb search: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml: unknown key "search.rrf_kk"
  [exit 1]

  $ write .kb/stores/default/config.toml @config-fixed

  $ kb config --path
  $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml

  $ kb search tmux --mode fts --caller claude
  search 1 · 2 hits
  [1] data/tmux.md › (intro) · updated 2026-02-01
  Tmux survives logout › (intro)
  # Tmux survives logout

  Start tmux on the remote host and detach.

  [2] data/tmux.md · updated 2026-02-01
  Tmux survives logout: Keep sessions alive after you log out of the remote host.
  search_id=1

A store that is not there, and a directory with no kb location at all.

  $ kb --store nope search tmux
  [stderr] kb search: no store "nope" in $WORK/proj and no alias of that name (stores: default; aliases: none); create a store with kb init --name nope
  [exit 1]

  $ cd $WORK/elsewhere

  $ kb search tmux
  [stderr] kb search: no kb location found in $WORK/elsewhere or its parents; run "kb init" here, or use --global / --root
  [exit 1]

-- notes/tmux.md --

summary: Keep sessions alive after you log out of the remote host.
tags: [ops]
updated: 2026-02-01
---
# Tmux survives logout

Start tmux on the remote host and detach.
-- elsewhere/.keep --

-- @kbtoml-broken --
version = 1
default_store = "default
-- @kbtoml-fixed --
version = 1
default_store = "default"

[aliases]
-- @config-badkey --
version = 1

[embed]
model = "fake:8"

[[sources]]
path = "data"
layout = "entries"

[search]
rrf_kk = 20
-- @config-fixed --
version = 1

[embed]
model = "fake:8"

[[sources]]

[search]
